_doc: Per-system corrections to the OEDI metadata, used by scripts/pvdaq_extract.py. Each entry needs a source. dc_kw: DC rating at STC. exclude: [start, end, reason] periods set missing before averaging.

50.source: SERF East: 140 x Siemens M55, 7.43 kW DC at STC; System.power 6.0 is the PTC AC estimate. van Dyk, Strand and Hansen (1996), NREL/CP-411-20430; NREL/TP-411-21285
exclude: ac_power_1 half-array peak down about 22 % from 2017 (ac_power_2 unchanged): not a healthy system
after the PVDAQ pipeline change no channel is AC power for long stretches (meters read about 480,000 day and night, inverter 1 15,000 at night); the rest runs at 0.13-0.58 x DC

51.source: SERF West (twin of SERF East, system 50): 140 x Siemens M55, 7.43 kW DC at STC; System.power 6.0 is the PTC AC estimate. van Dyk, Strand and Hansen (1996), NREL/CP-411-20430
